title: What proportion of customers who have accounts at the Prague branch are fem
question:
What proportion of customers who have accounts at the Prague branch are female?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Female refers to gender = 'F'; Percentage of female clients in Prague branch = count[female clients with accounts in Prague branch / count(clients with accounts in Prague branch)] * 100%; A3 may contain information about Prague

prediction.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM client AS "c" JOIN disp AS "d" ON "c".XCL_009 = "d".XCL_014 JOIN account AS "a" ON "d".XCL_015 = "a".XCL_001 JOIN district AS "dt" ON "a".XCL_002 = "dt".XCL_017 WHERE dt.XCL_019 = 'Prague'

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN district dt ON a.XCL_002 = dt.XCL_017
WHERE dt.XCL_019 = 'Prague'

columns: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
